comparison.objective: Fit two bevelled coupons to a specified weld root opening; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Reorient and precisely align two heavy plates in pose and gap versus recessed tool engagement, fine rotary tuning, bounded locking, and repeated cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Both bevels face inward with 1.6–3.2 mm gap and aligned ends versus two safe repeatable stops. Candidate response thresholds are not fully numeric.
comparison.reason: Static geometric fit-up does not test retained adjustment or dynamic response.
